offence_category.quote: Dishonour of cheque - ... Negotiable Instruments Act, 1881 - s.138
offence_category.reason: Cheque dishonour offence under NI Act fits the broad 'Other' category.

statutory_provisions.quote: Negotiable Instruments Act, 1881 - s.138 rlw. s.142
statutory_provisions.reason: Matches the statutory provisions discussed in the judgment.

evidence_type.quote: after appreciating the documentary evidence adduced on behalf of the parties
evidence_type.reason: Case rests on cheques, bank memos and postal-endorsed notices, i.e. documentary evidence.

confession.reason: No confession by the accused is mentioned.

aggravating_circumstances.reason: No aggravating circumstances are noted in the judgment.

mitigating_circumstances.quote: first respondent was willing to pay Rs. 2,00,000/- in lieu of suffering simple imprisonment
mitigating_circumstances.reason: Offer to pay in lieu of imprisonment is not framed as mitigation; 'None noted' is defensible.

trial_court_outcome.quote: the Trial Court by judgment dated 29-07-1993 convicted and sentenced the first respondent to undergo simple imprisonment of three months
trial_court_outcome.reason: Matches the trial court conviction and three-month sentence.

high_court_outcome.correct_value: Allowed the criminal revision, set aside the concurrent conviction findings, holding s.138 not attracted
high_court_outcome.quote: the High Court allowed the criminal revision of the first respondent by setting aside the concurrent judgments
high_court_outcome.reason: High Court did decide the revision; 'Not applicable' contradicts the judgment.

final_outcome.correct_value: Conviction upheld; High Court judgment set aside; sentence substituted by conditional deposit of Rs. 2,00,000 in lieu of imprisonment
final_outcome.quote: we set aside the impugned judgment of the High Court
final_outcome.reason: 'Convicted' is broadly right but omits the conditional payment in lieu of imprisonment.

offence_finally_established.quote: therefore Section 138 read with 142 of N.I. Act is attracted
offence_finally_established.reason: Court held s.138 r/w s.142 attracted, supporting this value.

imprisonment_type.correct_value: Fixed term of three months simple imprisonment, substituted by payment of Rs. 2,00,000 in lieu, with restoration if not deposited
imprisonment_type.quote: in lieu of suffering simple imprisonment of three months
imprisonment_type.reason: Fixed term is right, but the sentence was commuted to payment, which is omitted.

imprisonment_years.reason: Sentence was three months, i.e. 0.25 years, not 3 years.

fine_rs.reason: No fine is imposed; the Rs. 2,00,000 is a deposit in lieu of imprisonment.

neutral_facts.correct_value: Facts up to the High Court's reversal, without stating the Supreme Court's decision or reasoning on the outcome
neutral_facts.quote: The Supreme Court overturned the High Court's decision, finding that the first notice was valid and the second notice was merely a reminder.
neutral_facts.reason: Facts are accurate, but the final sentence reveals the Supreme Court outcome, which neutral facts must not do.

offence_severity.quote: shall be deemed to have committed an offence and shall ... be punished with imprisonment for a term which may extend to two years, or with fine which may extend to twice the amount of the cheque
offence_severity.reason: Quotes the statutory punishment under s.138, which is the applicable severity.

attempt_completion.quote: the drawer shall be deemed to have committed an offence under the Act
attempt_completion.reason: Offence treated as completed on dishonour and non-payment after notice.

physical_harm.reason: No physical harm is mentioned in the judgment.

number_of_offences.correct_value: One offence under s.138 relating to two dishonoured cheques
number_of_offences.quote: the first two cheques dated 13-10-1990 ... returned by the bank
number_of_offences.reason: Value is descriptive rather than a count; it omits that the complaint concerns a single s.138 offence.

financial_property_loss.quote: the first respondent failed to return the borrowed amount Rs. 64,000/-
financial_property_loss.reason: Rs. 64,000 is the borrowed amount stated as unpaid.

premeditation_planning.reason: No premeditation or planning is discussed.

motive.reason: No motive is identified; the judgment only notes non-return of the loan.

key_evidence_accepted.quote: the first notice sent by appellant on 12-04-1991 was effective and notice was deemed to have been served
key_evidence_accepted.reason: Accurately reflects the Court's acceptance of the first notice and reminder characterisation.

witness_credibility.reason: No witness credibility assessment is stated.

post_offence_conduct.reason: No post-offence conduct is discussed beyond postal non-service, which is not conduct as such.

bail_history.reason: The judgment refers to bail having been granted, so 'Not stated' is wrong.
